_readme: Approved YANA script, word for word. '|' marks phrase breaks only (not spoken): each phrase is synthesised separately and joined with a natural pause; captions follow the measured phrase timings. `offset` = seconds after the scene starts. Captions show 'YANA'; the voice is given 'Yana' so it says the name rather than spelling it. `phraseSpeed` slows one phrase where the default pace blurred a word (S3: 'simply being heard' was heard as 'hurt').

voice.direction: Female, Indian English. Warm, empathetic, natural; gentle but confident. Never rushed, never sad.

lines.text: Sometimes, you know something doesn't feel right. | But finding the words for it isn't always easy.
And when opening up feels difficult, | getting the right support can feel even further away.
What if taking care of your mental wellbeing started with simply being heard? | Meet YANA. | You Are Not Alone.
Start at your own pace. | Check in with how you're feeling, | explore what matters to you, | and find a space that understands your needs.
Reflect through journaling. | Discover bite-sized guidance. | Share your thoughts | and connect with a supportive community.

And when you're ready for more, | explore individual therapy, group sessions and professional support. | Because wellbeing isn't a one-time destination. | It's a journey, and you don't have to take it alone. | YANA. You are not alone.
